title: Management of Severe Plasmodium Falciparum Malaria With Oral Artemisinin Derivatives
official: Management of Severe Plasmodium Falciparum Malaria With Oral Artemisinin Derivatives
summary:
ACTs could be used as first-line treatment for Plasmodium falciparum malaria without clinical signs of severity but with biological severity criteria.

The study aims to determine the real-world frequency of ACT monotherapy use in cases of P. falciparum malaria with severity criteria, and to compare the treatment success of ACTs with that of artesunate.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Patients aged 18 years or older.
* Diagnosis of Plasmodium falciparum malaria.
* At least one clinico-biological criterion of severe malaria.
* Hospitalization in a medical intensive care/critical care unit.
* Hospitalization between January 1, 2011 and October 30, 2025.

Exclusion Criteria

* Age \<18 years.
* Patient who objects to the use of their data for research.
